name: kmeans-wasm-workspace
description: Development and release tooling for the kmeans-wasm npm package.

scripts.build: wasm-pack build --release --target bundler && node scripts/finalize-npm-package.mjs pkg
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm test && npm run package:check
scripts.package:check: npm run build && publint --strict pkg && attw --pack --profile esm-only pkg
